# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 109 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 109 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_109_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — Final Words and Commission

**1** "Lord, now that you've explained everything, answer me one more question: why wasn't the tower built on flat ground? Why was it built on a rock set in water?" **2** "You're asking the right question about the foundation," he said. **3** "Here is why: because your life was saved — and will be saved — through water. And the tower was founded on the word of the Almighty, the glorious Name. The Name of the Lord holds up the entire creation. **4** And so the tower, built on that word of the glorious Name, will stand forever — nothing can shake it, no storm of adversity or suffering." **5** "Lord," I said, "that is extraordinary. But tell me one more thing: **6** why were the repentant ones given the premier positions in the tower while those who hadn't yet repented were placed in the outer sections?" **7** "Because they were the first to respond to the call of repentance," he said, "and that's why they were placed closest to the gate. They were the first to believe after the Son of God revealed himself to them." **8** "What does the seal mean — the one given to those who entered through the gate?" I asked. **9** "The seal is the water," he said. "They go into the water dead and come up alive. **10** That's why the seal was also announced to these people — so they could enter God's kingdom." **11** Then he said to me: "Go and tell everyone with you the great and glorious things God has shown you. Don't hold any of these words back from them." **12** He showed me everything with great clarity. Then I fell asleep and he was gone.

---

*PNEUMA closes Similitude 9 with the commission as a call to proclamation, and the vision's conclusion with the terse, dreamlike "he was gone."*
